audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 3, 4 and 6 disagreed with the already-written quinn__yorick mirror, which sets row 3 to Quinn, row 4 to Skill and row 6 to Yorick. whys[5] also described Quinn deleting you while its own side field said Skill.
audit.why: Levels 4-5 are hers, not even — Behind Enemy Lines lets her leave and impact the map faster than Yorick can punish, which is exactly what whys[3] already said. Level 6 evens out because Eulogy of the Isles makes the swarm windows symmetric. Two-plus items is Yorick's: her ultimate is a travel tool, and no amount of mobility answers a Maiden taking a tower on the other side of the map.
audit.corrected: win[3]/phases[3].side to Quinn, win[4]/phases[4].side to Skill, win[6]/phases[6].side to Yorick as one paired group, ratings 3/5/6 on those rows. whys[5] and whys[6] rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown appeared anywhere (packet defect: sequencingCues 0), and spikes[3]/late treated late-game Quinn as the winner.
audit.why: The lane runs on Vault's 12/11/10/9/8s and Blinding Assault's 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s. Those two numbers are the whole trade clock and neither was written. Late game, Behind Enemy Lines is a travel and reveal tool — it does not take a tower, which is what decides a Yorick game.
audit.corrected: Vault's 12s and Blinding Assault's 11s written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t, dontsFull[0].d, spikes[0].text, early, breakdown.feeding and phases[0..5].why. spikes[3].text and late rebuilt around the side lane.

audit.whatIsWrong: The blind is attributed to the wrong ability throughout. spikes[0].text writes 'Blinded Vault (E)', and focus/dosFull/report label Vault as 'Dash/Blind'.
audit.why: Riot's Vault text is a dash that damages, slows, briefly interrupts the target and lands Quinn back near max attack range — no blind in it. The blind is Blinding Assault (Q), 1025 range on 11s, which 'hinders vision'. Getting this wrong makes the player dodge the wrong spell. The interrupt on Vault is the other unstated piece: it cuts your attack wind-up, so a Last Rites swing can be wasted by it. The one genuinely correct old claim is that Dark Procession denies her Vault escape — Riot's text says the wall blocks enemy movement — so that is kept and made explicit.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text, early, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t, dontsFull[0].d and dontsFull[1].d now attribute the blind to Blinding Assault and describe Vault as the 12s dash that slows, interrupts and lands her back at range.

notes: Packet suspectName 'Her Behind Enemy Lines' is a FALSE POSITIVE — that is Quinn's real R name in the kit file, and no change was made. The genuine name error is elsewhere and was missed by the detector: spikes[0].text writes 'Blinded Vault (E)', fusing the Q's blind onto the E. Riot's Vault text is a dash that damages, slows and briefly interrupts, landing her back at max attack range; the blind is Blinding Assault (Q) at 1025 range on 11s. The 'Dash/Blind' label on Vault in the report and trading blocks comes from the same confusion. Vault's interrupt is also newly stated — it can cut a Last Rites swing. Kit flag misfire as elsewhere: yorick.json tags Mourning Mist (E) 'dash'; Riot's text gives Yorick no movement, so no dash asserted.
